beats.text: A bomb brings down an airliner meant for China's Premier. Nehru sends one Indian police officer to find who did it.

beats.headline: THE FOUNDER
beats.text: Thirteen years later, that officer builds India's foreign intelligence service from scratch.
He warns that Pakistan's dictator may start a war. Thirteen days of fighting later, Bangladesh is born.

beats.headline: THE MAN NOBODY PHOTOGRAPHED
beats.text: And almost no photograph of him exists.

beats.headline: THE SPYMASTER
beats.text: RAW Files, Episode One. Now on The Sisodia Files.
